sentence.formula: A calculation with the numbers below

measure.name: Name in the legend
measure.letterHint: In formulas, this column is the letter {{letter}}.
measure.formulaHint: Use the other columns' letters: PERCENT(B, A), A - B.

filters.title: Only count when
filters.hint: Leave out what doesn't matter. All conditions must hold.

formula.label: The calculation
formula.stepsHint: Each has a letter. They can come from different sources.
formula.hint: Use the letters and functions above. Division by zero counts as zero.

guide.math: Math: A + B, A - B, A * 2, (A + B) / C
guide.percent: PERCENT(A, B): how much A is of B, in points. PERCENT(25, 200) gives 12.5.
guide.round: ROUND(A / B, 2): rounds to 2 places. There's also CEIL and FLOOR.
guide.compare: MIN(A, B), MAX(A, B), ABS(A - B), SQRT(A), POW(A, 2)
guide.if: IF(A > B, A, B): if the first part holds, the second; otherwise, the third.
guide.decimals: Decimals use a dot: 0.5. The comma separates a function's parts.

formula.breakdownHint: A number whose source doesn't have this split counts the same in every part.

errors.unknownIdentifier: I don't know "{{word}}". Use the numbers' letters and the functions listed.
errors.unexpectedCharacter: The character "{{char}}" can't be in the calculation.
errors.unexpectedToken: "{{token}}" is left over in the calculation. Decimals use a dot, not a comma.
errors.expectedToken: The calculation looks incomplete near "{{token}}". Missing a closing parenthesis?
errors.expectedExpression: The calculation stops midway: a number or letter is missing.
errors.undefinedStep: Number {{step}} doesn't exist in this calculation.

editor.tooManyParts: With {{count}} parts, the smallest become "Other". In bars, they all show and are easier to compare.
editor.noBreakdown: {{source}} has nothing to divide by. Change the source or the card type.
